responsibility: Defines the shared trait error-reporting support layer, wiring together the diagnostics submodules and providing common helper types, visitors, and utilities used to locate HIR nodes, classify impl candidates, summarize callable arguments, and support trait failure diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Among the `traits/*/mod.rs` files, this one is the diagnostics hub. Its code is centered on building and decorating trait-related errors, HIR visitors for locating source constructs, candidate-similarity reporting helpers, and argument-shape summaries, rather than performing solving, query execution, or specialization logic.
